description: Read the setup as it stands: the page map with each page's state (waiting, awaiting_approval, changes_requested, approved, applied, failed, skipped — a page the person unchecked is skipped), the approval mode the person chose, nextPage, runId and next, what to do now. While a plan waits for the person, poll it every few seconds without ending your turn (from a shell, `npx -y @mapled/cli tool get_setup '{"setupId":"<id>"}' --wait` waits for you): they approve on the Mapled screen and won't tell you here.
name: get_setup
